name: doole-skills
description: doolecg's Claude Code plugins: BlockDesigner, Claude Agent Viewer and Operant releases, Minecraft modding, and the Bottom Bar, Clean View and Flightdeck mods.

plugins.name: blockdesigner
plugins.description: Release BlockDesigner and its plugins, and scaffold new plugin repos (blockdesigner-release, blockdesigner-plugin-release, blockdesigner-plugin-new).

plugins.name: agent-viewer
plugins.description: Release Claude Agent Viewer: version bump, RELEASE_NOTES.md, launch check, dev branch, tag, MSI build and release check.

plugins.name: operant
plugins.description: Operant control (tiles, workers, task board, memory) and releasing Operant: version bump, RELEASE_NOTES.md, launch check, dev branch, tag, MSI build and release check.

plugins.name: voxel-icons
plugins.description: Draw app icons, plugin logos and mod icons as isometric voxel art in the BlockDesigner house style, and write every size a project needs.

plugins.name: minecraft-modding
plugins.description: Fabric and NeoForge modding with version-matched APIs, and migrating mods from 1.21.x to 26.1 (from siredvin/minecraft-modding-skills, MIT).

plugins.name: minecraft-multiloader
plugins.description: Architectury mods that share one codebase across NeoForge and Fabric, for Minecraft 26.x or 1.21.x (from jahrome907/minecraft-agent-skills, MIT).

plugins.name: minecraft-mod-dev
plugins.description: General Minecraft mod development: mod APIs (JEI, AE2, Create), dev environments and version migration (from mcpmarket).

plugins.name: design
plugins.description: Critique a UI from a screenshot with a ranked fix list (before/after shots), and design screens from colour, type, spacing and layout fundamentals. For desktop apps, Minecraft mod GUIs and HTML pages.

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: How I work, as skills: team work in Operant, the UI before/after flow, Minecraft test setup, desktop app baseline, general release flow and plain writing.

plugins.name: bottom-bar
plugins.description: A compact rounded bar at the bottom of the terminal (model, effort, context, 5h usage, agents) with a Doole's Tools pill that holds the mods you pick and opens a toolbox.

plugins.name: clean-view
plugins.description: A calm, plain-English checklist above the prompt while Claude works, with the tool calls, diffs and command output hidden.

plugins.name: flightdeck
plugins.description: A Flightdeck-style sidebar: the main session's vitals and every subagent working now, each with a pixel critter and a pixel progress bar, in the Bottom Bar's colours.
